name: DS Cluster D16: Cross-Commodity Adjustment Rules
description: Tests: NoAdjustment for ratios/spreads between assets, BackwardRatio for single-asset momentum. The adjustment trap.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D16: Cross-Commodity Adjustment Rules
# =============================================================================
# Rule: NoAdjustment for ratios/spreads, BackwardRatio for single-asset returns.

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === Two reference assets for ratio ===
gld = common_reference_stocks(ticker=ReferenceStock.GLD)()
tlt = common_reference_stocks(ticker=ReferenceStock.TLT)()

# === RATIO: GLD/TLT (uses raw prices — NoAdjustment equivalent) ===
# Reference stocks don't need continuation, but the principle applies:
# For cross-asset ratios, use RAW (unadjusted) prices.
ratio = gld.c / tlt.c
ratio_ma = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(ratio)

# === SPREAD: GLD - TLT ===
spread = gld.c - tlt.c

# === SINGLE-ASSET RETURNS (BackwardRatio equivalent) ===
# For returns/momentum on a single asset, adjusted prices are correct
gld_ret = returns(gld.c)
tlt_ret = returns(tlt.c)
spread_ret = gld_ret - tlt_ret

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="GLD/TLT Ratio (raw prices for ratio)",
    category="Adjustment",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Ratio", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="50d MA", color=Color.White)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(ratio, ratio_ma))

xy_lines(
    title="GLD - TLT Return Spread",
    category="Adjustment",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Spread Return", color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Zero")])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=cumulative()(spread_ret))
